comments.body: My best advice would be to learn German. There are positions that are purely english speaking, especially in startups, but it's still a major hindrance for finding a job. Courses to learn swiss norms on how to format a CV and a motivation letter may also be useful. Also, just because you start a job doesn't mean you have to do it forever. Moving from academia to the industry is the most difficult step, and it should get easier afterwards, so don't agonize too much on what your first job is. Good luck on your search!
comments.author: TriboarHiking
